data.one_liner: Android implementation of the google_sign_in plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android-specific implementation for the google_sign_in plugin, utilizing the underlying Android CredentialManager SDK and Google Identity APIs for authentication.
use_when: You are implementing Google Sign-In in a Flutter application targeting Android
You need to interact directly with the Android-specific APIs of the google_sign_in package
avoid_when: You are developing for platforms other than Android without needing platform-specific dependency management
You prefer using higher-level authentication providers like Firebase Auth exclusively without direct Google sign-in flows
strengths: Automatically included when using the endorsed google_sign_in package
Updated to use modern Android CredentialManager SDK and Kotlin implementation
weaknesses: Requires precise platform-side configuration (SHA signing keys, package names, web OAuth client IDs)
Certain underlying CredentialManager errors can manifest as generic cancellation errors
data.setup_notes: Register your application using Firebase or Google Cloud Platform, enable OAuth APIs like Google People, and ensure a web OAuth client entry is configured.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main endorsed federated plugin package that includes this Android implementation automatically.
